steps.speaker: Garden Member A
steps.content: Was everything smooth today? You weren't discovered, were you?

steps.speaker: Garden Member B
steps.content: Don't worry, I wasn't exposed. Hiding one's identity is fundamental for an assassin.

steps.speaker: Garden Member B
steps.content: I'm afraid the Mentor still needs to hide out here with us a bit longer.

steps.speaker: Garden Member B
steps.content: ...The Mentor?

steps.speaker: Garden Member A
steps.content: Shh... Don't disturb her. Just keep your guard up.

steps.speaker: Garden Member B
steps.content: By the way, while I was out today, I found an abandoned apartment.

steps.speaker: Garden Member B
steps.content: There're large floor-to-ceiling windows that bring in plenty of sunlight. It also got a courtyard, big enough for all of us.

steps.speaker: Garden Member A
steps.content: An apartment that can accommodate more than a dozen people is rare in Syndicate. Why was it abandoned?

steps.speaker: Garden Member B
steps.content: My guess is a Mania outbreak occurred there, but it doesn't affect Sinners like us anyway.

steps.speaker: Garden Member B
steps.content: Mentor, should we move there?
Everyone in the house turns their eyes to the white-haired woman by the window. However, she seems lost in thought, simply watching the people passing by outside.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Hm? I've told you, there's no more Garden and Mentor anymore. Just call me Ms. Coquelic.

steps.speaker: Garden Member B
steps.content: Ms. Coquelic, I've found a great place that could serve as a new home for the Garden.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I said, there's no Garden anymore! Cough, cough...
Her sudden outburst silences everyone.

steps.speaker: Garden Member A
steps.content: Your health...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I'm fine... Go on with your tasks.
Realizing she lost her temper, Coquelic curls back into her spot by the window.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I can give you life, give you time to find a new Garden, and keep you far away from all the troubles.
Heh... you must have used your power to control me in the end... Otherwise, how could I have been so stupid to believe you...
You Paradeisos bastard, where are you... where have you hidden them...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I have to find them as soon as possible...
Coquelic falls weakly into the mud. Her fine white nightgown is covered in mud.
Normally, she would have been disgusted and gone back for a hot petal bath. But now, she couldn't care less with the wounds and blood stains all over her body.
Mentor! I've found them!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Thistle! Is this everyone...? Where are the rest?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Where is Garofano?!
They lower their heads in silence. Looking at the wounded members of the Garden, blood surges up Coquelic's throat.
In the dim light of the street lamp, they finally see the blood stains all over Coquelic.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Cough, cough... Cough...

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: Mentor! You're injured! It looks really bad...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I'm fine... When have you ever seen me not okay?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: We should get going. Those armored bastards have sharp noses. The blonde chick bought us some time. Don't let them find us.

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: Christina said, most of them were sent to Syndicate. We'll go find them. As long as everyone comes back, the Garden will...
At the end of the dimly lit alley, the sound of armor hurriedly passes by.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ...Listen, the Garden was completely destroyed in the confrontation with the FAC.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: From now on, there's no Garden.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Before the words are fully out, a figure clad in orange blasts free from the duct, her disruptive power active. The entire venue's systems instantly fail.
Coquelic doesn't raise her head, as if she is avoiding the hopeful gazes.
She just helps a wounded companion get up while supporting herself with her wand, and leads the way.
Better not tell them and make them worry. It will only cause trouble.
I don't have much time left, seven days... What else can I do?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Ugh...

steps.speaker: Garden Member A
steps.content: Mentor! Are you okay?! Your old injuries act up again?

steps.speaker: Garden Member B
steps.content: That damn woman from Paradeisos. I'll settle the score with her sooner or later!

steps.speaker: Garden Member A
steps.content: Even the Mentor is not her match... What are we going to do? We've finally found some comrades in Syndicate, are we going out to be targeted again?

steps.speaker: Garden Member B
steps.content: But... she hurt so many people in the Garden. Shouldn't we do something about it?!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Cough, cough... Who said we're not going to do anything...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: There's no such thing as "tolerance" in the Garden's mottos. If someone hurts us, I'll pay them back.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I won't let those flowers suffer in vain.
I just need an opportunity, an opportunity "created by others."

steps.speaker: Garden Member A
steps.content: How many days has the Mentor been sitting by the window?

steps.speaker: Garden Member B
steps.content: Shh, she might be thinking about something, don't disturb her.

steps.speaker: Garden Member B
steps.content: Come help me in the kitchen. It's time for dinner.
Five days left. Those guys really know how to bide their time...

steps.speaker: Garden Member A
steps.content: I've checked it out. That apartment was indeed abandoned because of Corruptors.

steps.speaker: Garden Member A
steps.content: It was once occupied by a gang for a while, but they were defeated in a fierce battle and left.

steps.speaker: Garden Member B
steps.content: Maybe we can move there and set up a new base.

steps.speaker: Garden Member B
steps.content: In the new base, we'll double our training. One day, we'll revenge those who are gone.

steps.speaker: Garden Member A
steps.content: I want to plant lots of flowers in the courtyard and make a garden...

steps.speaker: Garden Member A
steps.content: Those destroyed flowers will surely grow back.

steps.speaker: Garden Member B
steps.content: Yeah, Mentor will definitely like it!

steps.speaker: Garden Member B
steps.content: Mentor...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Hmm? Oh.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Whatever... You guys can decide.

steps.speaker: Garden Member B
steps.content: Oh... okay.
Seeing how halfhearted she is, everyone stops discussing the topic with disappointment. Coquelic remains lost in thought.
Three days left. It's about time.

steps.speaker: Garden Member A
steps.content: It seems like the outside world has really forgotten about us.

steps.speaker: Garden Member B
steps.content: It hasn't been that long.

steps.speaker: Garden Member A
steps.content: There have been a lot of big events in Syndicate recently. And in a turbulent time like this, assassins are most needed.

steps.speaker: Garden Member A
steps.content: The Garden may have stopped taking orders, but there are still Yagyu and Carnivores... they definitely won't miss this opportunity.

steps.speaker: Garden Member A
steps.content: Now the streets are full of Sinners, and one less Sinner organization makes no difference.
No. He will come, I know better than anyone else.
steps.female_content: No. She will come, I know better than anyone else.

steps.content: As long as that power exists, he is the last threat, the existence that binds the Garden.
steps.female_content: As long as that power exists, she is the last threat, the existence that binds the Garden.

steps.content: Bang!!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Finally...!

steps.speaker: Garden Member A
steps.content: What?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Everyone inside the house, you are surrounded. Please do not resist and cooperate!

steps.speaker: Garden Member B
steps.content: It's the MBCC!

steps.speaker: Garden Member
steps.content: Mentor, we'll cover you. You retreat first.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I repeat: Sinners of the Garden, you are surrounded. Surrender now. We mean no harm.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Hahahaha... cough cough!

steps.speaker: Garden Member A
steps.content: ...Mentor?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I told you, remember to hide your identity. Call me Ms. Coquelic.
Finally leaving her spot by the window lazily, she positions her wand at the door.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: They're such an important guest. I should personally receive them.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Go now, useless girls. You're not needed here. Live the lives you want!
As Coquelic speaks, she releases powerful Mania, blasting the house's front door wide open.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Careful, it's high concentration pollution! Raise the Hypercube shields for protection!

steps.speaker: Garden Member B
steps.content: Mentor, your wounds haven't healed. You can't use this power again...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: It doesn't matter anymore, none of it matters!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Get lost, even if you have to step on my body!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Hahaha, there's no Garden anymore! What use does the Mentor have?
The currents of Mania are eating away at Coquelic's life, distracting the enemy.
Blood is dripping from the corner of Coquelic's mouth, but instead of slowing down, she pushes forward with immense pressure.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Maintain your defense. Seal the perimeter!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: They have a secret passage at the back! A dozen of Sinners have escaped!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Then focus on the front door, trap the S-Class Sinner!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It's the Chief's order. Coquelic, the Garden's Mentor, must be brought back!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Hahaha, finally! Finally!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: MBCC, we should have met long ago!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Concentrate fire!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Come on! Shoot me. Let me die with my secrets! Hahahaha...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Let's see just how powerful the famous MBCC is!
...Just how much of a threat it can pose to my Garden!
Coquelic is a completely different person from the weak patient a few days ago.
She raises her dangerous power high, laughing wildly amidst the flashes of gunfire and smoke. Her bare feet step on the hot bullet shells as she nonchalantly strides towards the enemy.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: She's coming!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Don't back down! Keep firing! Block her escape route!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: My dear Adjutant, don't worry. I won't run, I've been waiting for you!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Don't you want to take me back, to catch up with Gekkabijin and Sumire? Cough cough...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: By the way, your Chief must be eager to see me, right?
Her old wounds are torn open again, but Coquelic's laughter becomes even more manic. The bullets are blocked by her Mania, unable to harm her.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Is she planning to take all the attacks alone?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Our ammunition won't last much longer! Requesting support from the Bureau!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: No... there's no need.
Nightingale waves her hand, and the guards slow their attack in confusion. When the smoke clears, they finally see that Coquelic has fallen to the ground.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: She's drained her power.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: What about the other members of the Garden?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: They all ran away. Should we chase them?
Everyone is waiting for a definitive command. A figure in a grey coat steps out from among the guards.
It's fine. Let them go. Perhaps that was her goal.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll put the shackles on her. Let's take her back.
I still have... one last day...
He finally came.
The blurry environment sounds mix with the monologue in her mind, until that familiar yet strange voice echoes in an enclosed space.
Wake up.
Stop pretending you're asleep, Mentor of the Garden.
Tell me, what exactly happened in Eastside. You and the Garden, why did you get involved?
The strange feeling of the shackles in her veins is crystal clear, and the blinding light finally forces her to open her eyes.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Cough... Chief, should I say, "It's nice to meet you," or...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: "It's been a while"?
